malababa.title: Malababa
malababa.synopsis: A prestigious notary and a police officer have been invited and carefully walk through Doña Amelia de Blasco's estate under the dim light. Step by hesitant step, they approach the imposing mansion, unaware of the evening that awaits them. That woman, hated and feared throughout the province, arrogant, disrespectful and selfish, announces that during the dinner she has prepared she will reveal who her future heirs will be. Family members, friends and servants all have the chance to change their lives if they are chosen, and they will do anything to achieve it. But Aunt Amelia has a bad feeling. Will it change her plans at the last minute? Who truly deserves the inheritance? Let the gramophone begin to play.

hero.title: Answering the most common questions from authors.
hero.description: We know that publishing a book raises many questions. Here you'll find answers to the most frequently asked questions about our services, our workflow, and how we can help you turn your manuscript into a professional publication.

items.question: Do I retain the rights to my work?
items.answer: Yes. Always. The copyright remains entirely with the author of the work.

items.question: Are you a traditional publishing house?
items.answer: No. We help you prepare your manuscript so you can submit it to traditional publishers or choose the independent publishing route.

items.question: Do you publish my book directly?
items.answer: No. We provide professional services for independent authors who need support at any stage of their publishing project.

items.question: Do you guarantee book sales?
items.answer: No. No serious professional can guarantee book sales. Our job is to help you present your work with the highest possible quality.

items.question: Can I hire just one service?
items.answer: Yes. You can hire only the service you need, with no obligation to purchase any others.

items.question: Do you work with authors outside Spain?
items.answer: Yes. We work with authors both in Spain and abroad, entirely online.

items.question: How long does the process take?
items.answer: It depends on the type of service and the scope of the project. Before we begin, we always provide an estimated timeline that we are committed to meeting.

items.question: How do I make the payment?
items.answer: Payment can be made by bank transfer or any other method agreed upon in advance with the author.

items.question: If I need a service you don't offer, can you still help me?
items.answer: Yes. As an art direction studio, we are open to new proposals and to providing customized solutions whenever we can help.

hero.title: We don't publish books.
hero.titleHighlight: We support those who write them.
hero.description: Chamuskado Brain was born from a very simple idea: every great story deserves a chance. Behind this project there is no big company or a team of dozens of people. It's just the two of us.

story.title: Creative people, not a big company

paragraphs.first: It's just the two of us. Creative people who decided to combine our professions to help other authors turn their manuscripts into books they can be proud of.
paragraphs.second: While one imagines worlds with pencil, ink and a graphics tablet, the other polishes words, structures stories and guides authors through the entire editorial process. Two different disciplines with the same goal: caring for each work as if it were our own.

narrative.first: Chamuskado Brain was born years ago as a creative project where illustration, literature and design coexisted. Over time it evolved into an editorial studio specialized in self-publishing and services for independent authors.
narrative.second: We know what it means to finish a manuscript and not know what the next step is. We've been there too. We've written, edited, illustrated, laid out, designed and published our own works. We've learned from the process, from our mistakes and from experience. And that's precisely why today we can support other writers from a close and genuine perspective.
narrative.third: We don't believe in contracts that strip away rights, nor in impersonal formulas. We believe in stories, in craftsmanship, and in the importance of offering a human, transparent and fully personalized service.
narrative.fourth: Every project that comes to Chamuskado Brain is unique. We don't work with templates or automated solutions. We listen, advise and adapt each service to every author's needs, because we understand that behind every book there are months — or even years — of great excitement, effort and dedication.
narrative.fifth: Our commitment is to help your work see the light with the quality it deserves, without ever losing its essence.

story.closing: Because books change when they pass through our hands. But they remain yours.

paloma.name: Paloma Castizo
paloma.bio: Writer, professional editor and proofreader. Specialized in editorial support for independent authors, manuscript review, reading reports and self-publishing. At Chamuskado Brain she coordinates every project and guides authors from the first draft through to the publication of their work.
paloma.quote: I believe good editing isn't about changing an author's voice, but about helping their story reach the reader exactly as it deserves.

victor.name: Víctor Tourbillon
victor.bio: Artist and illustrator specialized in traditional drawing and digital techniques. Responsible for Chamuskado Brain's visual identity, he develops covers, illustrations and custom graphic projects to bring each story to life.
victor.quote: Every illustration is a doorway into a story. My job is to make the reader want to open it.

philosophy.title: Books made with care
philosophy.paragraph: We believe in books made with care, in illustration created by hand before going digital, and in edits that respect the author's voice. In design that conveys the essence of a story, and also in supporting every writer with the same enthusiasm we bring to our own projects.
philosophy.closing: Welcome to our little scorched brain.

Family, friends and staff all have the chance to change their lives if they're chosen. And they will do anything to make it happen. But Aunt Amelia has a bad feeling. I recommend it 100%.
From the very first moment it builds intrigue and pulls you into the story. A fantastic book.

1.title: Highly recommended!
1.content: A highly recommended book — from the very first moment the plot hooks you with unexpected twists and an ending that won't leave anyone indifferent.

2.title: A book that speaks to you
2.content:
Wonderful. A book that speaks to you, pulls you in, makes you feel part of it. Holding it in your hands is a treasure. Great edition and great work on the format.
Bravo, Paloma.

cartas-a-bruno.title: Letters to Bruno
cartas-a-bruno.synopsis: An escape. A journey. A forgotten reason that has brought her to the secluded little town of Portrush, in the north of Ireland. A chain of mysterious letters and sinister events will shake her reality, forcing her to look for a way out. An ending that was already written. What happened to Miss Lain?

0.title: Highly recommended
0.content:
The story's protagonist is Olivia, who, tired of city life and stress, moves to Portrush, a small town in the north of Ireland. There she settles into a rented house. Once the author sets this scene with a hint of mystery, Oli starts receiving anonymous letters and then… I won't say any more to avoid spoilers.

I found it amazing how the author describes in such detail what Olivia feels at every moment, as if you were inside her mind, going through the same anguish.

The setting chosen for the story is perfect, full of mystery and intrigue, reminiscent of those abandoned towns from horror films.

The plot is completely addictive and the final chapter is nerve-wracking. The author constantly plays with your mind and the outcome is completely unexpected.

I fully recommend this psychological thriller.

1.title: Wanting more titles!
1.content:
A small great discovery of an excellent psychological thriller, with an unsettling atmosphere and very well-built tension.

Every chapter keeps up the anticipation of what might happen to Olivia in Portrush.

The reading is very enjoyable, and Paloma's narrative ease in guiding the reader stands out. Even the author's bio perfectly reflects what her stories are like.

Looking forward to more of her successes!

2.title: Highly recommended
2.content: A suspense story that won't let you put the book down until you finish it. Extremely gripping and a very quick read. Highly recommended!

3.title: Highly recommendable.
3.content: A story where nothing is what it seems, and it hooks you from start to finish. I look forward to reading more books by this new writer.

4.title: Buy it!!!! Don't hesitate!!!
4.content: A great story that pleasantly surprised me. Highly recommended. This author, Paloma Castizo, won't go unnoticed. She'll grab you from the very beginning.

5.title: Highly, highly recommended!!!
5.content:
Letters to Bruno is a small work of art: fragile, subtle and terrifying.

A psychological horror novel with an atmosphere full of mystery. A cold, dark and confusing thriller that grips you from start to finish. And an ending nobody can predict.

Letters to Bruno is scary and leaves a bitter aftertaste, like Mrs. Margeritte's cookies.

6.title: Thrilling
6.content:
A book that keeps you wondering what's going to happen throughout the whole story. It grips you at every moment, reads very quickly, and the ending leaves you speechless.

I'd love to read more stories by this author. I see a great future for her as a writer. Congratulations, Paloma!

7.title: Very good book
7.content:
It holds your attention and the mystery until the end. It left me speechless and I even wanted more.

Now that I know the ending, I want to read it again to catch all the details I didn't understand before. A smooth, easy and very addictive read.

8.title: An essential thriller
8.content:
It's a completely addictive psychological thriller where nothing is what it seems.

Throughout its nearly 200 pages, there isn't a single moment without anguish or even terror.

The ending is absolutely unexpected and impactful. I recommend it 100%.
